scope: Nonempty candidate extraction interruption/resume/replay, without automatic acceptance or canonical promotion.
assertions: A successful chunk persists a quote-grounded nonempty candidate before later interruption.
Interrupted state remains incomplete and no completed result exists.
Resume reuses successful chunk with no repeat call.
Repeated equivalent candidates from later chunks produce one stable candidate.
Completed replay makes no additional backend calls.
Full chunk coverage remains distinct from domain review completion.
limits: Scripted provider fixture, not live quality validation.
Candidate identity and quote verification do not imply accepted facts, legal source entailment or complete downstream reviewed-promotion integration.
